gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: difficulty moving left arm upon waking this morning. Generated cc-001: woke up unable to move left arm (~1 hr ago). Content aligns; adds timing but does not conflict.
Gold: no pain despite inability to move left arm. Generated hpi-001: painless paralysis of the left arm. Same clinical meaning.
Gold: no previous similar episodes. Generated hpi-008: reports no prior similar episodes. Direct match.
Gold: slept normally the night before symptom onset. Generated only mentions no unusual sleep position (hpi-009), which is not the same as confirming sleep was normal.

Gold: no discoloration of the left hand and arm does not feel cold. Generated hpi-007: no discoloration or coldness of the hand. Effectively captures the same clinical point about no vascular compromise to the limb, although wording differs slightly.
Gold: symptoms confined to left arm, not in left leg. Generated hpi-006: no left leg symptoms. Same meaning.
Gold: tingling on left side of face for about one hour. Generated hpi-002: tingling of the left side of the face. Duration is missing but the presence/location are covered.
Gold: patient has not noticed facial asymmetry. No generated fact addresses presence or absence of facial asymmetry.
Gold: difficulty swallowing water resulting in dribbling. Generated hpi-003 and hpi-004: dribbling when drinking and difficulty swallowing. Together they cover this fact.
Gold: speech harder or slower than usual. Generated hpi-005: slower speech. Matches the described symptom.
Gold: patient was alone at home when symptoms occurred. No generated fact explicitly states that no one else was at home.
Gold: type 2 diabetes mellitus. Generated pmh-001: history of type 2 diabetes mellitus. Direct match.
Gold: hypertension. Generated pmh-002: history of hypertension. Direct match.
Gold: takes metformin. Generated med-001: taking metformin. Direct match.
Gold: takes losartan. Generated med-002: taking losartan. Direct match.
Gold: takes amlodipine. Generated med-003: taking amlodipine. Direct match.
Gold: allergic to penicillin. Generated allergy-001: allergic to penicillin. Direct match.
Gold: father has heart disease. Generated fh-001: father had heart disease. Tense differs but clinical fact is the same.
Gold: lives alone. Generated sh-001: lives alone. Direct match.
Gold: ex-smoker. Generated sh-002: ex-smoker. Direct match.
Gold: mild–moderate alcohol intake. Generated sh-003: drinks a few pints on weekends and a couple mid-week, which operationalizes a mild–moderate intake without contradicting it.
Gold: impression is possible CVA. Generated asm-001: suspected acute CVA with specified deficits and timing. This includes and refines the same impression.

Gold: LAS called, blue light. Generated plan-001: emergency response activated and ambulance dispatched for ED/stroke team evaluation. It captures the dispatch of an emergency ambulance; additional detail (CT, thrombolysis) is extra but not conflicting.

Gold: patient to keep front door open. Generated plan-002: advised to unlock door, sit in hallway, stay on line until EMS arrival. Unlocking the door conceptually corresponds but 'open' vs 'unlock' are not identical; additional instructions are extra.

Gold: caller will remain on the line until ambulance arrives and will hand over. Generated includes advice for the patient to stay on the line but does not mention the caller staying on the line or handing over.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Same complaint: woke up unable to move left arm; generated adds approximate timing (~1 hr) not specified in gold.
Painless left arm paralysis is consistent with no pain and inability to move left arm.
Reports tingling of left side of face; matches gold tingling left side of face, though duration not mentioned.
Dribbling when drinking corresponds to gold dribbling water when trying to swallow.
Reports difficulty swallowing; consistent with gold difficulty swallowing water.
Slower speech matches gold perception of speech being harder or slower.
No left leg symptoms aligns with symptoms limited to left arm and not in left leg.
No hand discoloration or coldness matches gold no discoloration of hand and arm doesn't feel cold. Slight wording difference (arm vs hand) but same clinical concept of no peripheral ischemia.
No prior similar episodes matches no previous similar episodes.

Generated: no unusual sleep position prior to symptom onset. Gold: slept as per normal last night. The source text for generated uses a different, more specific negative (no unusual position) not present in gold; since gold only states sleep was normal in general, asserting specifically 'no unusual position' introduces an unsupported detail. Treated as contradiction to maintain rigor on small details.
Symptom onset approximately one hour before encounter is not specified in gold facts, though consistent with the clinical scenario. This timing detail is new.
History of type 2 diabetes mellitus directly matches gold.
History of hypertension directly matches gold.
Taking metformin matches gold medication list.
Taking losartan matches gold medication list.
Taking amlodipine matches gold medication list.
Allergic to penicillin matches gold.
Father had heart disease matches father has heart disease.
Lives alone matches gold.
Ex-smoker matches gold.
Specific pattern of alcohol intake (few pints weekends + couple mid-week) is more detailed than gold's mild–moderate alcohol intake and not derivable from it; thus it is an addition.
No vitals/PE due to telephone consult is not mentioned in gold facts. New information about exam limitations.

Summarizes neurologic deficits (including terms dysarthria, dysphagia) as physical findings. Gold lists these only within HPI/assessment-like descriptions and does not explicitly define a PE section; this structured PE summary is additional.
Suspected acute CVA aligns with impression of possible CVA; additional detail on deficits and onset is additive but not conflicting.
States T2DM is stable on metformin; gold only notes presence of T2DM and metformin use, not stability, so this is an added clinical judgment.
Hypertension being treated with losartan and amlodipine is inferred from meds and PMH but not explicitly assessed in gold as treatment status; treated as an addition.
Ambulance dispatched with emergency response matches LAS called–blue light. Extra details about ED/stroke evaluation, CT, and thrombolysis candidacy are additions but consistent.
Advice to unlock door aligns with gold instruction to keep front door open, but generated adds sit in hallway and stay on line until EMS arrival, which are not present in gold and are additional.
Advice to continue current medications and note that this was discussed is not mentioned in any gold plan fact.
Deferring chronic management of T2DM/HTN until after the acute issue is addressed is not in the gold plan; this is new management detail.
